scenarios.title: Normal egress
scenarios.description: 70,000 people leave the Coliseum after the final whistle.

scenarios.title: Expo Line delay
scenarios.description: E Line signal failure: no trains leave Expo Park/USC from minute 10 to minute 25.

scenarios.title: BMO Stadium event
scenarios.description: An event at BMO Stadium lets out: about 400 extra people per minute join the station walkway from minute 15 to minute 35.

scenarios.title: Walkway sensor outage
scenarios.description: The Bluetooth counters on the station walkway stop reporting from minute 5. The crowd itself is the same as normal egress.
